Based on the miniq codebase:

**(1) Function that computes the delay before a retry:**
`miniq/retry.py:20` — `next_delay()`

**(2) Default maximum delay in seconds:**
30 seconds (config value `RETRY_MAX_DELAY_S = 30.0`, applied as the default for `max_delay` at `miniq/retry.py:11`)

**(3) Default number of attempts after which a job stops being retried:**
5 attempts (`RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5` at `miniq/config.py:7`; `should_retry` at `miniq/retry.py:18` returns False when `attempt >= max_attempts`, so on the 5th attempt it no longer retries).
